note: Build settings. Every build writes BOTH channels: 'live' (content/library, read by the live site) ships only published records in active languages; 'preview' (content/preview, read by the preview site and localhost) adds drafts and in-review languages so they can be tried. 'test' is used by the test suite only (adds test-only languages such as the sample Arabic pack) and is never written into the repo. Records left out are pruned with their references (e.g. a World Land place pointing at a draft country disappears) and the report lists them.
